THE GREYHOUND

Pub & Dining

A welcoming village pub in the heart of the community.

Get directions Call · 01244 740231

A proper village local

A relaxed, friendly place on Seahill Road, a few minutes out of Chester — whether you're popping in for a quick pint or sitting down to a quality home-cooked meal.

Cask ales on the bar, a proper list of wines, beers and spirits behind it, and a kitchen that cooks everything in house. Dogs are welcome, there's a small car park round the back and a beer garden for when the weather plays along.

What you'll find here

Food Wednesday to Sunday, cask ales all week, and the bar open every day.

Home-cooked pub classics

Everything cooked here from scratch. Served Wednesday to Saturday, 12pm to 8pm, and Sunday 12pm to 6pm.

Sunday lunch is back

Sunday roasts return on 27 September, served 12pm to 6pm — and they go until they're gone.

Dogs, a fire and a beer garden

Dogs are welcome throughout, the fire is lit when it needs to be, and there's a small car park at the back.

Our menus

Food served Wednesday to Saturday 12–8pm, Sunday 12–6pm. Menus are on their way.
